digest.component_or_area: git-fetch test suite / dribbling fake remote
propositions: Full suite scheduler load intermittently causes git-fetch dribble tests to fail stall-detection checks due to delayed wake-ups reducing actual throughput below the configured rate.
Tests apply the same artificial 2-second stall window to both zero-byte positive controls and above-floor negative controls, causing valid dribble traffic to appear stalled under scheduling delays.
Cumulative bytes-owed calculation fixes repeated late wake-ups but cannot recover after libcurl aborts during an uninterrupted scheduling gap longer than the configured window.

The deterministic remedy splits fast zero-byte stall controls (using 2-second window) from one production-window dribble integration test (using 10-second window) and removes redundant timing trials at wrapper call sites.
